question: In October 2020, which of the following Ministries launched the Ayushman Sahakar Scheme, to assist cooperatives in the creation of healthcare infrastructure?

options.text: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

solution:
The correct answer is __**Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In October 2020, the **Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare** launched the Ayushman Sahakar Scheme.
 
• The scheme aims to assist cooperatives in the creation of healthcare infrastructure.
 
• It provides financial assistance to cooperatives for the establishment, modernization, expansion, repairs, renovation of healthcare infrastructure, and services.
 
• The scheme is expected to play a crucial role in strengthening the healthcare services in rural areas.
 
• National Cooperative Development Corporation (NCDC) is the implementing agency for this scheme.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Ayushman Sahakar Scheme aligns with the objective of the National Health Policy, 2017.
 
• It is part of the government's effort to achieve universal health coverage and improve the quality of healthcare services in the country.
 
• The scheme also encourages the participation of cooperatives in the healthcare sector, promoting a cooperative model of healthcare delivery.
 
• The financial assistance under this scheme includes term loans, working capital loans, and interest subvention.
 
• The scheme is expected to benefit millions of people by enhancing the availability of healthcare facilities, especially in underserved and rural areas.
